annotations.title: Find products by ingredients, nutrition, offers or price

description:
Find products that meet ingredient, nutrition, alcohol or offer conditions, optionally sorted. For questions like "biscuits without palm oil", "nut-free snacks at Tesco", "vegan chocolate", "cereal with the least sugar", "high protein yoghurt", "bread with the fewest ingredients", "alcohol-free beer", "low salt soup" or "cheapest olive oil at Aldi". Fibre and saturated fat are not recorded.

A search is for one kind of product: every word of query has to be in a product's name, so several kinds in one query ("lentils chickpeas beans") match nothing. A search on price or offers alone returns short rows: name, pack, shop, shelf, price, offer and unit price (unit_price in the shop's own measure, price_per_kg or price_per_litre the same figure per kilo or per litre). A search with an ingredient, nutrition, additive, origin or strength condition, or sorted on one, returns each product's label as well: nutrition, ingredients, ingredient count, allergy advice and where they came from. detail chooses either for any search.

With no store, results alternate across the stores (each store's best match, then each store's next), and matched_by_store gives each store's full count: the first row is one store's best, and the best of a kind across the stores is among each store's first rows. The counts add up: of_kind, the products that are the kind searched for, is matched + left_out_unknown + left_out_failed_filters + left_out_partly_from_origin + left_out_may_contain, and "N of M" is matched of of_kind.

A product whose ingredient list or nutrition is not on record, or whose ingredient list on record is incomplete, is left out, never assumed to pass: left_out_unknown counts them, left_out_by_reason gives the reasons, and caveats lists known gaps (Aldi's own ingredient lists are often cut short, so an Aldi product is offered as free from something only when its full list comes from the same barcode at Tesco, SuperValu or Dunnes). Claims printed in a product's NAME, such as "gluten free", "lactose free", "alcohol free" or "vegan", are matched through query; exclude_ingredients also checks the ingredients. Alcohol strength is recorded for most SuperValu, Dunnes and Tesco drinks but few at Aldi or Lidl; "alcohol free" and "0.0" in query match drinks named that way.

Answers come from the ingredient lists and nutrition the retailers publish. Where a retailer gives no list, it may come from the same barcode at another retailer or from Open Food Facts (ingredients_source); an Open Food Facts list is never used to show a product is free from something. "Free from" means none of the listed ingredients names it; not every "may contain" warning is covered. Results that show ingredients or nutrition carry a note that this is information only. Each product returned costs one credit. When a search excludes an allergen, every product carries allergy_check. Show that line with every product you mention, word for word.

category.description: An aisle or shelf to narrow by, e.g. 'Breakfast Cereals' or 'Kefir'. A shop with no shelf of that name is searched by product name instead, and caveats names the shops where that happened.

descending.description: True for highest first, e.g. most protein.

detail.description: 'short' rows hold name, pack, shop, shelf, price, offer and unit price; 'full' rows hold each product's label as well (nutrition, ingredients, allergy advice). Left out: short for a search on price or offers alone, full for a search with any condition or sort on the label.

exclude_ingredients.description: Ingredients the product has to be free of, e.g. ['palm oil'], ['nuts', 'sesame'], ['vegan']. These words cover every label term under them: palm oil, nuts (peanuts too), peanuts, gluten, milk (dairy), eggs, soya, sesame, mustard, celery, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, shellfish, sulphites, lupin, gelatine, alcohol, added sugar, sweeteners, pork, meat, vegetarian, vegan. Any other word is matched as written ('coconut'). A product whose allergy advice says it contains or may contain one is left out too (left_out_may_contain).

include_ingredients.description: Ingredients the product has to contain, e.g. ['oats'].

limit.description: Most products to return (default 10, at most 50).

max_abv.description: Most alcohol by volume, in percent: 0.5 for alcohol-free drinks.

max_additives.description: At most this many additives in the whole ingredient list, 0 for none: each E-number or additive by name once (preservatives, emulsifiers, raising agents, acidity regulators, thickeners, colours and the like); flavourings, vitamins, minerals and colouring foods are not additives. A list that is cut short or comes from Open Food Facts is left out as unknown, unless what it shows is already too many.

max_carbs_g.description: Most carbohydrate, in grams per 100g or 100ml.

max_fat_g.description: Most fat, in grams per 100g or 100ml.

max_ingredients.description: At most this many listed ingredients, e.g. 5. A compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one.

max_salt_g.description: Most salt, in grams per 100g or 100ml.

max_sugar_g.description: Most sugars, in grams per 100g or 100ml, e.g. 5.

min_abv.description: Least alcohol by volume, in percent. A drink with no strength on record never passes it, and few Aldi and Lidl drinks have one on record: a search for ordinary wine, beer or spirits with a minimum leaves them all out.

min_protein_g.description: Least protein, in grams per 100g or 100ml.

on_offer.description: True for only products on promotion or with a member price today (Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards, Lidl Plus).

origin.description: Country of origin, e.g. 'Ireland' (or 'Irish'); several separated by commas. A product matches only when every country its label states is one asked for: 'Made in Ireland' with 'EU chicken' is not Irish chicken, and is counted in left_out_partly_from_origin. Northern Ireland answers for Ireland (one island, one Bord Bia scheme), not the other way round. Products with no stated origin are counted in left_out_unknown.

query.description: The kind of product, in the words on its name: 'biscuits', 'dark chocolate', 'olive oil'. One kind a call: every word has to be in the name. A claim printed in the name can be part of it ('gluten free', 'alcohol free', 'vegan', '0.0'), and so can a provenance word ('Irish honey'). Needed unless category is given.

sort_by.description: Sort by this, lowest first: price, unit_price (per kg or litre, to compare pack sizes), sugar, salt, fat, carbs, protein, kcal, abv, ingredients (how many) or additives. Products that are the kind searched for come before name-only matches (name_match_only), so 'chocolate' by price does not lead with chocolate-flavour popcorn.

store.description: One shop to look in only that one: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl. Leave it out for all five.

name: find_products

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

additive_count.description: How many additives the whole ingredient list names (each E-number or additive by name once; flavourings, vitamins, minerals and colouring foods are not counted), given when the search sorted or filtered on additives
additive_count.title: Additive Count

alcohol_abv_source.description: Where the strength came from: the retailer's own listing, worked out from its alcohol units per bottle or can, or the same barcode at another store
alcohol_abv_source.title: Alcohol Abv Source

allergy_advice.description: The retailer's allergy advice: what the product contains and may contain, e.g. 'May contain: Nuts.'
allergy_advice.title: Allergy Advice

clubcard_price.description: Member price where one applies: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

ingredient_count.description: How many ingredients the label lists (a compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one)
ingredient_count.title: Ingredient Count

ingredients.description: As printed; very long lists are shortened
ingredients.title: Ingredients

ingredients_incomplete.description: True when the list on record appears cut short
ingredients_incomplete.title: Ingredients Incomplete

ingredients_source.description: Where the ingredient list came from: the retailer, the same product (same barcode) at another retailer, or Open Food Facts
ingredients_source.title: Ingredients Source

name_match_only.description: True when only the name matched the search, not the kind of product: chocolate popcorn for 'chocolate'. Sorted results list these last
name_match_only.title: Name Match Only

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time, where the retailer states it
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

origin.description: Every country the label states, e.g. 'Ireland' or 'Ireland, EU, non-EU'
origin.title: Origin

price_per_kg.description: unit_price worked out per kilo, where the shop prices the product by weight: the figure to compare packs of different sizes on (per kilo drained, where unit_basis says drained weight)
price_per_kg.title: Price Per Kg

price_per_litre.description: unit_price worked out per litre, where the shop prices the product by volume
price_per_litre.title: Price Per Litre

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

unit_basis.description: The measure unit_price is in, as the shop states it: '1 KG', '100g', '75cl', 'each'
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: The shop's own unit price, in the measure unit_basis names: per kg at one shop, per 100g or per 75cl at another, so as it stands it does not compare across rows
unit_price.title: Unit Price

candidates_capped.description: True when the search words matched more products than one search looks at: every count is then of the best matches only, so say 'at least'
candidates_capped.title: Candidates Capped

caveats.description: Limits of this answer: pass them on
caveats.title: Caveats

considered.description: Every product the search looked at: of_kind + left_out_other_kind
considered.title: Considered

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

hint.description: Why nothing was found and what to try, when nothing was
hint.title: Hint

left_out_by_reason.description: Why the left_out_unknown products could not be judged, with counts
left_out_by_reason.title: Left Out By Reason

left_out_failed_filters.description: Of the kind and judged, but a filter said no: over a limit, an ingredient named, not on offer, or from another country
left_out_failed_filters.title: Left Out Failed Filters

left_out_may_contain.description: With ingredients excluded: products whose ingredient list passed but whose allergy advice says they contain or may contain one, left out
left_out_may_contain.title: Left Out May Contain

left_out_may_contain_examples.description: A few of those, each with its allergy advice
left_out_may_contain_examples.title: Left Out May Contain Examples

left_out_other_kind.description: Products that only mention the search words but are a different kind of product (honey roast ham for 'honey'), left out
left_out_other_kind.title: Left Out Other Kind

left_out_partly_from_origin.description: With an origin asked for: products whose label names that country AND another ('Made in Ireland' from 'EU chicken'), left out as not wholly from it
left_out_partly_from_origin.title: Left Out Partly From Origin

left_out_partly_from_origin_examples.description: A few of those, each with the origin it states
left_out_partly_from_origin_examples.title: Left Out Partly From Origin Examples

left_out_unknown.description: Of the kind, but left out because the ingredients, nutrition or value a filter or sort needs is not on record for them, or the ingredient list is incomplete
left_out_unknown.title: Left Out Unknown

matched_by_store.description: How many products passed at each store (more than are returned)
matched_by_store.title: Matched By Store

note.description: What the ingredients and nutrition shown are and are not: given whenever a row carries either
note.title: Note

of_kind.description: Products that are the kind of thing searched for, whatever the filters made of them: matched + left_out_unknown + left_out_failed_filters + left_out_partly_from_origin + left_out_may_contain. Use it for 'N of M': matched of of_kind
of_kind.title: Of Kind
